support_claim: Unresolved-preservation propositions document a possible separate registry entity and explicit legal uncertainty, so identity between billing:Northbridge Analytics Inc. and contract:MSA-NBA-2021 cannot be closed as same or distinct.

propositions.proposition: Billing records use the billed name "Northbridge Analytics Inc."
propositions.relevance: Grounds the left referent billing:Northbridge Analytics Inc. to the name appearing on invoices.

propositions.proposition: The MSA-NBA-2021 contract lists the counterparty as "Northbridge Analytics, Inc."
propositions.relevance: Grounds the right referent contract:MSA-NBA-2021 to the named counterparty on that agreement.

propositions.proposition: Commercial notes state that billing and the MSA both use the name "Northbridge Analytics Inc."
propositions.relevance: Documents name alignment between the billing referent and the MSA counterparty, but does not establish they are the same legal registry entity.

propositions.proposition: Commercial notes state that sales uses the short name "Northbridge Analytics"
propositions.relevance: Indicates an additional informal name variant in use for the counterparty, adding naming ambiguity.

propositions.proposition: A 2024 credit check returned a Wyoming LLC named "Northbridge Analytics LLC"
propositions.relevance: Introduces a separate registry entity that could be the contracting party, preventing closure of identity between billing and the MSA.

propositions.proposition: Legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party
propositions.relevance: Explicitly preserves that identity between the billing referent and the MSA counterparty cannot be established from available records.

propositions.proposition: The registry link between name variants and a specific legal entity is to be treated as unresolved
propositions.relevance: Directly instructs that the identity relation between billing:Northbridge Analytics Inc. and contract:MSA-NBA-2021 must remain open.
